subject: Post-discovery: PrivDeploy demo & architecture deep dive — scheduling
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Ames <jordan.ames@mercuryhealth.com>, Alex Torres <alex@mercuryhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: PrivDeploy demo & architecture deep dive — scheduling

Hi Jordan / Alex —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: run a technical deep dive focused on private/VPC deployment architecture, network requirements, and an ops run-through for a PoC.
- Attendees we recommend: Mercury infra lead, your security contact, one of your SREs + our PrivDeploy engineer (Priyom) and an account lead (Neha).

To make scheduling easy I pulled a couple of windows that work on our side:
- Thu Nov 25, 10:00–11:00 PT (30–45m deep dive + Q&A)
- Fri Nov 26, 08:30–09:15 PT (compact technical run-through)

Can you let me know which works or suggest two slots that fit your ops calendar? I attached a short precall checklist (network ports, firewall policy, and existing VPN/peering notes) and a CSV of the minimal network matrix to make the call productive.

Precall ask: whoever will own networking on your side, could they drop a few lines about whether you use IPsec VPN, AWS Transit Gateway, or direct connect? That will help Priyom prepare specific diagrams.

Thanks — we’ll hold the two windows until you confirm.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.inference
Attachments: privdeploy-precall-checklist.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); network-requirements.csv (CSV, 1 file)

From: Jordan Ames <jordan.ames@mercuryhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex@mercuryhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: PrivDeploy demo & architecture deep dive — scheduling

Mina —

Appreciate the recap and the checklist, very helpful. Quick answers before we lock a slot:
- Network: we currently run AWS Transit Gateway for cross-account connectivity, and we also have a site-to-site VPN for our on-prem datacenter.
- Security: our InfoSec lead is out this week but can join if we book after Mon Nov 29.

Of the two windows you proposed, Thu Nov 25 at 10:00 PT looks good for our infra lead and Alex. If InfoSec can’t make it, we’d like to capture their questions and follow up in a short asynchronous thread or a separate call.

Two small asks for the call: could you include a short agenda (30/45m) and confirm whether you will share a diagram of the proposed network topology in advance? That will help our SRE prep.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Ames
Director, Infrastructure
Mercury Health
jordan.ames@mercuryhealth.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Ames <jordan.ames@mercuryhealth.com>, Alex Torres <alex@mercuryhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: PrivDeploy demo & architecture deep dive — scheduling

Thanks Jordan — great, we’ll hold Thu Nov 25 10:00 PT. Agenda below (we'll keep to 35–40m):

1) 5m – Introductions and scope alignment (Mina)
2) 10m – Proposed private/VPC deployment topology and public/private subnet mapping (Priyom)
3) 10m – Network ports, peering, and expected latency considerations (Priyom + Jordan questions)
4) 5–10m – Ops runbook highlights (Neha) and next steps for PoC (timing, access, contacts)

I’ll upload a simple topology diagram and a short runbook excerpt to the Drive link and share in this thread by EOD today. Priyom — adding you explicitly so you can highlight anything we should add to the agenda.

If you prefer, here is a quick calendar scheduling link: https://calendly.com/mina-privdeploy/30min — happy to drop an invite if you confirm the Thu slot.

Best,
Mina
